caption:
Shadow work journaling is everywhere right now. And for overthinkers, it's a trap — your brain will take "dig into your wounds" as permission to spiral into the past with no exit. The Surface First starts with today, not your childhood. We're building a guided journal for overthinkers — DM "JOURNAL" for a free sample. Save this.

#journaling #shadowwork #overthinking #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: do shadow work in your journal — the most dangerous advice online
